rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for a male member of a royal family, especially a king's son.

example.english: That film is about a prince who falls in love with a commoner.
example.traditional: 嗰套戲講一個王子愛上咗平民。
example.jyutping: go2 tou3 hei3 gong2 jat1 go3 wong4 zi2 oi3 soeng6 zo2 ping4 man4

rows.note: Use this formal title when the prince is the ruler or head of a principality, rather than an ordinary royal son.

example.english: This prince is the ruler of that principality.
example.traditional: 呢位親王係嗰個公國嘅領袖。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 can1 wong4 hai6 go2 go3 gung1 gwok3 ge3 ling5 zau6

rows.note: Use this idiomatic expression for someone outstanding or preeminent among other people, not for a royal title.

example.english: In the tech world, they are truly a prince among people.
example.traditional: 喺科技界，佢真係人中龍鳳。
example.jyutping: hai2 fo1 gei6 gaai3 keoi5 zan1 hai6 jan4 zung1 lung4 fung6
